messages:
Ava (PM): ok team — proposing a compact observability slice for next sprint, codename "Scope Lantern". Goal: fast surface for dashboards that highlight cost hotspots + error spikes, plus lightweight tracing hooks for hot call paths. TL;DR: must-have dashboard widgets (cost breakdown, error rate by route), trace hook sampler for top 10 routes, launch criteria and rollback plan.
Marco (Eng): sounds good. can you list concrete launch criteria? also what's the expected perf overhead?
Ava (PM): good Q. draft acceptance criteria: 1) dashboard surfaces per-route cost with token-level approximation within 10% error for top-5 routes, 2) error spike alerting (5m window, >3x baseline), 3) trace hooks that capture full KV timeline for sampled requests, 4) end-to-end rollout with canary and auto-fallback, 5) docs + one customer-facing notebook. perf target: <2% p99 latency uplift on normal traffic.
Priya (Eng-SRE): sampling/trace detail — prefer adaptive sampling to avoid cost blowup. propose default sample_rate 0.01 with route overrides for high-volume endpoints. need to ensure trace captures correlation_id across internal hops.
Marco (Eng): adaptive sampling makes sense. rough implementation plan: host-side trace hook that attaches on request entry and emits to our trace pipeline async. use header propagation X-Req-Trace. cheap path when not sampled.
Lina (Data): for cost breakdown we can approximate token costs by mapping model name + token delta. need one off-job to backfill for last 30d for customers who request baseline. also cardinality risk — per-route + model + org could explode. suggest aggregation tiering (route -> service -> org).
Jonah (Design): dashboard UX notes: default view should be a small "lantern" card showing three KPIs (cost delta, error delta, p95 latency). drilldown to route table with sparklines. include quick toggle to turn trace sampling on/off per route. keep it compact for Console home.
Ava (PM): nice — owners: Marco does trace hook + rollout, Priya does sampling configs & SRE gating, Lina does cost aggregation, Jonah does dashboard mock + small UX copy. I can handle docs + customer notebook.
Priya (Eng-SRE): one more: add kill-switch flag per-tenant (feature-flag) and per-region fallback to low-fidelity cost summaries. also need an SLO for sampling overhead (e.g., no more than 3% extra tail CPU).
Marco (Eng): sample config suggestion (for infra team):
```
tracer:
  default_sample_rate: 0.01
  hotpath_threshold_ms: 40
  route_overrides:
    "/v1/generate": 0.08
    "/v1/embeddings": 0.02
  emit_async: true
  header: X-Req-Trace
```
Priya (Eng-SRE): that looks fine. bump hotpath_threshold if we see noise. also add a circuit-breaker: if trace pipeline error rate >1% then stop sampling for 10m.
Lina (Data): for cost accuracy let's target: top-5 routes accuracy within 10%, long-tail routes within 25% (stretch). we'll add a daily background job to recalibrate token-per-op factors based on model changes.
Jonah (Design): MVP screenshots uploaded to figma -> link (figma.com/scope-lantern). small UX request: make the error spike annotation clickable to open the trace sample (if available).
Ava (PM): customers mentioned: Vanta Corp asked specifically for per-route cost to drive optimization. Q: can we ship minimal dashboard without per-route historical by launch?
Marco (Eng): yes we can ship near-realtime windowed per-route (last 24h) as MVP, historical rollups (30/90d) as follow-up. that'll reduce initial ETL.
Priya (Eng-SRE): rollout plan: stage 1 = internal beta (20% traffic on staging account), stage 2 = enterprise pilot (selected orgs), stage 3 = general availability with feature-flag default off. canary windows 24h with healthchecks: p95 latency, token processing error rate, trace pipeline success rate.
deploy-bot: Canary for Scope Lantern scheduled: Tue 03:00 UTC -> 24h window.
Ava (PM): risks: 1) cost blowup from naive sampling 2) cardinality causing dashboard query slowness 3) inaccurate cost mapping after model quant updates. Mitigations noted in doc.
Marco (Eng): ok I'll spike the hook today and send a tiny PoC PR with the header and async emission. will include perf microbench.
Priya (Eng-SRE): I'll add sampling circuit-breaker and the feature-flag gate. Lina will validate top-5 route accuracy on a small dataset.
Ava (PM): next steps: owners agreed. I'll post a one-pager and acceptance checklist by EOD. please react with :thumbsup: when you ack the owners.
Marco (Eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup:
Lina (Data): :thumbsup:
Jonah (Design): :thumbsup:
Ava (PM): thanks — closing thread and moving this into the roadmap sprint ticket.
